name: Skyharbour Resources Ltd.
content: Skyharbour Resources Ltd. is a pre-eminent uranium exploration and project generator company with an extensive portfolio of projects in the Athabasca Basin of Saskatchewan, Canada. The company holds an interest in over 580,000 hectares of mineral claims, including its flagship Moore Uranium Project and the South Falcon Point Project. Skyharbour utilizes a prospect generator model, partnering with other companies to fund exploration and advance its secondary projects while focusing its own resources on high-grade discovery potential at its core assets. The company is well-positioned to benefit from the growing global demand for carbon-free nuclear energy.

Officers

Jordan Trimble(Date: 2013 June)

President and CEO

Jordan Trimble is the President and CEO of Skyharbour Resources. He has worked in the resource industry in various capacities with numerous TSX Venture listed companies and has a background in corporate finance and management. He has been instrumental in the growth and development of Skyharbour and has helped raise significant capital for the company.

Jim Pettit(Date: 2013 June)

Chairman of the Board

Jim Pettit is the Chairman of the Board and has over 30 years of experience in the resource industry specializing in finance, corporate governance, and management. He has served as a director and officer for several public companies.

David Billard(Date: 2013 June)

Head of Exploration

David Billard is a P.Geo. and the Head of Exploration for Skyharbour. He is a geologist with over 35 years of experience in exploration and development, particularly in the Athabasca Basin. He has worked with companies like Cameco and JNR Resources.

Nicholas Revere(Date: 2018 January)

VP of Corporate Development

Nicholas Revere is the VP of Corporate Development. He has experience in the financial markets and corporate communications within the resource sector.
